attchmntText: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has announced the closure of its trading window for designated persons. The restriction is effective from 27th November, 2026, until 48 hours after the announcement of the Board Meeting outcome. The Board Meeting is scheduled for 1st December, 2026. This closure applies to promoters, directors, key managerial personnel, designated employees, connected persons, and their immediate relatives. These individuals are advised not to deal in the company's shares directly or indirectly during this period. The notice is issued pursuant to the SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited intimates that its Board of Directors approved the re-designation of key managerial personnel on 26th November 2026. Mr. Sandeep Patel is re-designated from Company Secretary to Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective 27th November 2026. Mr. Abhishek Jain is re-designated from Chief Financial Officer and Compliance Officer to Chief Financial Officer, also effective 27th November 2026. Mr. Patel holds membership number F13157 with the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and has over seven years of experience. Mr. Jain holds membership number A19827 with the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and has over ten years of experience. The company has filed this disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 26, 2026.
voiceSummary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited approved the allotment of 3,25,000 warrants of Rs. 283/- each to six promoter and promoter group members on preferential basis. The warrants are convertible into 3,25,000 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each at a premium of Rs. 273/- per share. Upfront payment of Rs. 70.75 per warrant is required, with the balance of Rs. 212.25 payable within 18 months. Allottees include Shri Mohan Lal Choudhary, Shri Anil Choudhary, Shri Ravindra Choudhary, Shri Pramal Choudhary, Smt Vidhya Choudhary, and Shri Ashay Choudhary. The securities are subject to lock-in restrictions under SEBI ICDR Regulations, 2018. The Board also approved the re-designation of Mr. Sandeep Patel as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, and Mr. Abhishek Jain as Chief Financial Officer, effective 27th November, 2026.
